terms.definition: An increase in the observed wavelength of light from galaxies moving away from us.
The further away a galaxy is, the faster it is moving and the bigger the red-shift: the universe is expanding.
The universe began from a very small, extremely hot and dense region.
Observations suggest there is still much about the universe that is not understood.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Supernovae data suggest the expansion is speeding up.
